game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: ThePipSquee
quote: You somehow have less freedom and agency than previous GTA titles. The graphics are fantastic, but the gameplay dragged. As a female gamer, I had some interest in a main female character in the main story. But Lucia was just annoying. She is so toxic in a non-funny way... i found myself trying to distance myself from her, but you are unfortunately stuck with her.
